bio: Barnett Hill is a contemporary hotel in the Surrey Hills perfect for feasting, revelling and relaxing.  Perched atop their Hill, guests can enjoy magnificent views across Surrey while indulging in a delicious Afternoon Tea.  The hotel offers a host of Afternoon Tea experiences , which can be enjoyed in cosy lounges, The Oak Room restaurant or Drawing Room or (weather permitting) on a beautiful garden terrace.  Or why not try their Silent Pool gin Afternoon Tea in the new Silent Pool garden where you can enjoy three Silent Pool gin drinks & cocktails carefully selected to complement your sweet and savoury treats?
